This allocation will spread out the portfolio's maturity risk and provide a cushion against potential inflation-related market volatility. It's essential to maintain a laddered maturity structure to ensure that the portfolio remains liquid and can meet its cash flow obligations. Our target maturity distribution is: 15% in the 1-year bucket, 20% in the 5-year bucket, 20% in the 7-year bucket, and 45% in the 10-year bucket. By doing so, we can effectively manage our cash flows and inflation risk while minimizing excess duration of 10 years.
